name: Star Mountain
description: The flagship roller coaster of Beto Carrero World — Star Mountain is a spectacular steel coaster that delivers high-speed twists, inversions and dramatic drops through an elaborately themed mountain environment. The most thrilling and iconic coaster at Brazil's largest theme park and a must-ride for any coaster enthusiast visiting South America. Min 130cm.

name: Tigor Mountain
description: A thrilling family coaster themed to a tiger mountain adventure at Beto Carrero World — delivering exciting drops and twists through a dramatic jungle environment. One of the most popular family-thrill coasters at Brazil's premier theme park. Min 120cm.

name: Big Tower
description: A towering free-fall drop tower at Beto Carrero World — Big Tower raises riders high above the Santa Catarina coastline before releasing them in a breathtaking freefall with panoramic ocean views. One of the most spectacular drop towers in South America. Min 130cm.

name: Fire Whip
description: An intense spinning flat ride delivering powerful rotational forces as riders are whipped around in multiple axes simultaneously — Fire Whip is one of the most popular and intense flat rides at Beto Carrero World. Min 130cm.

name: Spin Blast
description: A high-energy spinning ride delivering intense rotational thrills at Beto Carrero World. One of the most exciting flat rides in the park. Min 120cm.

name: Crazy River
description: A thrilling river rapids ride through dramatic jungle waterways — Crazy River delivers exciting white-water rapids with guaranteed soakings and is the most popular water ride at Beto Carrero World on hot Brazilian summer days. Min 110cm.

name: Tchibum
description: A classic log flume water ride delivering a splashing final drop — Tchibum is a beloved Beto Carrero World institution and one of the most popular family water rides at Brazil's largest theme park. Min 100cm.

name: Super Soaker Splash
description: A spectacular water attraction at Beto Carrero World featuring high-speed water slides and splash elements — the perfect summer attraction on Brazil's warm Santa Catarina coast. Min 110cm.

name: Barco Pirata
description: A classic Viking ship pendulum ride swinging to increasing heights — a beloved family thrill and one of the most popular accessible attractions at Beto Carrero World. Min 110cm.

name: Roda Gigante
description: A magnificent Ferris wheel delivering breathtaking panoramic views over the Santa Catarina coastline and the surrounding landscape — one of the most scenic attractions at Beto Carrero World. Suitable for all ages.

name: Rebulico
description: A fun and chaotic spinning family ride delivering unpredictable rotational movements — Rebulico is one of the most popular and rerideable family attractions at Beto Carrero World loved by visitors of all ages. Min 90cm.

name: Florianopolis Show
description: A spectacular live entertainment show at Beto Carrero World celebrating the culture and energy of Brazil's Santa Catarina region — featuring professional dancers, elaborate costumes and vibrant Brazilian music. The most popular daily show at Brazil's largest theme park. Suitable for all ages.
